notes.text: The linked Niddah gives Abba Shaul bar Nash (בר נש) with bar Remesh as an alternative. Hyman has ben Remesh. [Heilprin’s Remesh entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3249&lang=en) lists Abba Shaul as his son.
